annotations.title: How can I watch MSNBC on the Internet? – NBC News Group

content.text:
To watch **MSNBC live online**, the official option is:

**MSNBC Live:** `msnbc.com/live`  
You’ll usually need to **sign in with a participating TV provider** for unlimited live streaming. NBC’s help page says MSNBC is always streaming there, but live access requires a supported TV-provider login. ([nbcnews.zendesk.com](https://nbcnews.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45174673222931-How-can-I-watch-MSNBC-on-the-Internet?utm_source=openai))

If you don’t have cable, legal streaming services that commonly include MSNBC may include **YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, DirecTV Stream,** or **Fubo**—availability and free trials change often, so check current plans before signing up.

For **free legal options**, MSNBC/NBC often provides **clips, selected segments, and live audio** in its apps or on its site, but the full 24/7 live TV feed generally isn’t free. Avoid “free MSNBC live stream” sites that aren’t official—they may be unreliable or unauthorized.
